description: SenML location profile test vectors per spec appendix-senml F.3. Error vectors carry an 'error' field holding the exact oracle rejection message; encode rejects have no cbor_hex because the encoder refuses the input. Missing base fields (bn/bt) are legal per RFC 8428 and deliberately NOT an error case (see senml-location-minimal).

vectors.description: Minimal location (lat, lon only, no base)
Location with lat, lon, alt (no base)
Location with base name and time
Location with accuracy fields but no alt/speed/heading
Encoder MUST reject latitude above +90 (lichen.senml.profiles.location range check).
Encoder MUST reject latitude below -90 (lichen.senml.profiles.location range check).
Encoder MUST reject longitude outside [-180, 180] (lichen.senml.profiles.location range check).
Encoder MUST reject NaN coordinates (lichen.senml.profiles.location finite check). The "NaN" string sentinel stands in for float('nan') when driving the oracle.
vectors.error: lat nan is NaN or Inf

vectors.description: Decoder MUST reject a non-string unit label (RFC 8428 u must be tstr; lichen.senml.codec.unpack type check). Bytes emitted by the reference CBOR codec.
vectors.error: SenML field 'u' must be a string, got int

vectors.description: Decoder MUST reject a non-numeric value (RFC 8428 v must be num; lichen.senml.codec.unpack type check). Bytes emitted by the reference CBOR codec.
vectors.error: SenML field 'v' must be a number, got str

vectors.description: Decoder MUST reject a record carrying more than one value field (RFC 8428 one-of v/vs/vb/vd; lichen.senml.codec.unpack check). Bytes emitted by the reference CBOR codec.
vectors.error: SenML record must have at most one value field
